channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Reinstating Nvidia's Huang Is a Terrible Mistake, Says Elson
item.description: Charles Elson, University of Delaware founding director of the Weinburg center for corporate governance, says it was a "terrible mistake" for Nvidia to bring back Jensen Huang as ceo and president. He speaks on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Jensen Huang’s Return to Nvidia Ramps Up Congressional Probes
item.description: Investors rejoiced when Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia but lawmakers only grew more determined to investigate the CEO.
item.dc:creator: Steven T. Dennis

item.title: Trump Slams Newsom for Commuting Death Sentences in 2028 Preview
item.description: President Donald Trump turned his criticism to a potential 2028 Democratic presidential candidate, calling California Governor Gavin Newsom’s commutations of death sentences for hundreds of inmates “one of the most shocking acts of injustice our country has ever seen.”
item.dc:creator: Jimmy Jenkins

item.title: Nvidia Rehires Huang in Stunning Comeback Following Trump Push
item.description: Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as head of the company, citing the US government’s input and saying his reinstatement is in the best interests of stockholders, employees, partners and customers. Huang’s return follows weeks of turmoil at Nvidia after he was pushed out over revelations of multiple extramarital affairs, including one with a subordinate and another with a woman the US government has investigated for spying on behalf of China. Ed Ludlow, Bloomberg Tech Host break down the return of Jensen Huang to Nvidia. Mary Ann Bartels, Chief Investment Strategist at Sanctuary Wealth and Seth Fiegerman, Bloomberg News AI Editor on market reaction. Plus, Michael Shepard, Bloomberg News Executive Editor of Technology & Strategic Industries. All on the latest episode of "Bloomberg Businessweek Daily." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: What to Expect When Huang Comes Before Congress
item.description: Bloomberg Contributor Patrick McHenry, a former Republican Rep. from North Carolina, talks about what to expect when Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang appears before Congress on Dec. 3. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nvidia Rehires Huang Amid Trump Push
item.description: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondents Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz discuss Nvidia reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO. On today’s show, Arbroath Group Managing Partner Christopher Smart, Rep. Sharice Davids (D-KS), Stonecourt Capital Partner Rick Davis, The Watchdog Report Publisher Kurt Bardella and former Republican Congressman Patrick McHenry. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Halts Detonation in Iowa, Puts Onus on Incoming Governor
item.description: A controlled detonation of hazardous materials stored at an Army facility in Iowa is on hold pending an appellate court decision and the agreement of the state’s incoming Democratic governor, President Donald Trump said Monday, warning that the delay raises the risk of “a large, spontaneous explosion.”
item.dc:creator: Courtney McBride

item.title: Nvidia at 'Heart' of National Security, AI Future, Says Christopher Smart
item.description: Christopher Smart, founder of Arbroath Group and former special assistant to the president at the National Economic Council during the Obama Administration, said that Trump's push to reinstate Jensen Huang as the CEO of Nvidia shows that the company is at the heart of the future of US national security and AI innovation, as well as holding up a major piece of the US economy. Smart said there are high stakes for the AI trade and that if the AI build out starts to unravel the US would be 'talking about a recession pretty quickly.' (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Huang’s Return Followed Unprecedented Intervention by Trump
item.description: President Donald Trump and his AI-friendly allies believed only Jensen Huang could revive Nvidia Corp.’s fortunes and reverse a massive stock-market slide. So they went to work to reinstate the beleaguered tech titan.
item.dc:creator: Iain Marlow and Kate Sullivan

item.title: US Intel Helped Nab Mexico Cartel Leader Without Agents on Site
item.description: The US provided intelligence leading to the capture of a suspected Mexican drug kingpin, but no US agents took part in the deadly operation, according to Mexico’s government.
item.dc:creator: Alex Vasquez

item.title: UK Review of Disability Benefits to Shy Away From Near-Term Cuts
item.description: A long-awaited government review into the soaring cost of the welfare payments received by disabled Britons will recommend overhauling the system, without proposing immediate spending cuts.
item.dc:creator: Chloe Chaplain and Joe Mayes

item.title: Spain Poll Shows Feijóo on Track to Oust Sánchez as Premier
item.description: Final polls ahead of a Nov. 29 election signal that center-right leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo is set to become Spain’s next prime minister, ending Pedro Sánchez’s eight-year term.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Basteiro

item.title: NATO to Send AWACS Plane to Poland After Russian Missiles Crash
item.description: NATO will deploy an airborne warning and control system aircraft to Poland to monitor the country’s eastern region, a deputy defense minister said, after three Russian missiles crashed there last week.
item.dc:creator: Natalia Ojewska

item.title: Jensen Huang Will Testify Publicly Before Senators Next Week
item.description: Newly reinstated Nvidia Corp. chief executive officer Jensen Huang will testify publicly before a powerful Senate committee on Dec. 3, according to a statement from the panel’s chairman.
item.dc:creator: Emily Birnbaum and Maggie Eastland

item.title: UK’s Burnham Explores Free Trade Deal With Thailand
item.description: The UK is exploring whether to negotiate a free trade agreement with Thailand, in what would be the first new set of talks since Andy Burnham became prime minister.
item.dc:creator: Lucy White

item.title: Burnham Says ‘Unthinkable’ to Join EU Without UK Referendum
item.description: Prime Minister Andy Burnham said it would be “unthinkable” for Britain to re-join the European Union without a referendum, the clearest indication he’s given yet about how his Labour administration could steer any decision on the UK’s future ties with the bloc.
item.dc:creator: Joe Mayes

item.title: New Hacked Data Puts Russian Death Toll in Ukraine Near 500,000
item.description: New data from a trove of hacked documents shows that at least 470,000 people on the Russian side have died as a result of President Vladimir Putin’s war on Ukraine, a higher figure than previously reported.
item.dc:creator: Alberto Nardelli, Priyanjana Bengani, Jeff Kao, Daryna Krasnolutska and Vivien Ngo

item.title: Trump Enlisted Vance in Campaign to Rescue Nvidia’s Jensen Huang
item.description: President Donald Trump pushed hard to reinstall Jensen Huang as chief executive officer of Nvidia Corp. after becoming convinced he is essential to the artificial intelligence industry, according to people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Kate Sullivan and Josh Wingrove

item.title: Allies Say Russia May Launch Nuclear Space Weapon Next Month
item.description: Western intelligence agencies warned that Russia has built a satellite designed to carry a nuclear warhead and could launch it as soon as next month, according to people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Michael Nienaber

item.title: Ukraine Sinks Russian Warship off Libyan Coast as War Widens
item.description: Ukraine claimed responsibility for sinking a Russian warship and another sanctioned vessel off the coast of Libya in what President Volodymyr Zelenskyy called an exemplary operation in response to Moscow’s war.
item.dc:creator: Olesia Safronova
